name.en: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana

description.en: Free foodgrain through the Targeted Public Distribution System for eligible Antyodaya Anna Yojana and Priority Household ration-card beneficiaries.

benefit_summary.en: Antyodaya households receive 35 kg of foodgrain per family per month and Priority Household beneficiaries receive 5 kg per person per month under the current central entitlement. Portability is supported through One Nation One Ration Card.

eligibility_summary.en: The household or person must be identified under the applicable Antyodaya Anna Yojana or Priority Household category and hold the relevant ration-card entitlement. State and Union Territory authorities identify eligible households.

name.en: Valid AAY or PHH ration card or entitlement details
Aadhaar authentication where it is linked and required by the ration system

notes.en: Ask the fair-price shop or food department about an approved exception when authentication fails.

instruction.en: Check the household's AAY or PHH ration-card entitlement with the state food department.
Collect the monthly entitlement from an authorised fair-price shop, including through portability where available.
Use the state food-department grievance channel if quantity, authentication, or portability fails.
